title: Streaming Recurrent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.34833v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural intelligence learns from a continuous stream of sensorimotor experience: data can arrive at high bandwidth, and behavior adapts to feedback as soon as it arrives, even when it is delayed. In contrast, most modern deep learning systems rely on stored datasets, replay buffers, and retained contexts through which credit is later assigned. At high data rates, storing and revisiting past experience can be impractical under tight memory and computational constraints. This paper studies recurrent memory under a streaming learning constraint: the learner learns from experience as soon as it arrives without storing raw experience. We ask whether a streaming learner can maintain a state that remains useful for future prediction and control from delayed feedback. translated_abstract: 自然智能从连续的感觉运动经验流中学习：数据可以以高带宽到达，行为能够随着反馈的到来立即适应，即使反馈存在延迟。相比之下，大多数现代深度学习系统依赖于存储的数据集、重放缓冲区和保留的上下文，并通过它们事后进行信用分配。在高数据速率下，在严格的内存和计算约束下存储并回溯过去的经验可能是不切实际的。本文研究了流式学习约束下的循环记忆问题：学习者在经验到达时立即学习，而不存储原始经验。我们探讨了一个问题：流式学习者能否维持一个状态，使其在未来基于延迟反馈进行预测和控制时依然保持有用？我们提出了流式循环记忆（SRM），这是一种专为流式环境设计的循环记忆，它在保留未来可能重要的信息的同时，保持可训练性……
tldr: 本文提出流式循环记忆（SRM），一种在无法存储原始经验、必须从实时到达的经验流中学习的约束下，仍能保留未来潜在有用的信息并从延迟反馈中持续学习与控制的循环记忆架构。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Streaming Recurrent Memory (SRM), a recurrent memory designed for the streaming learning setting, which preserves potentially useful information while learning from experience as it arrives without storing raw data, enabling prediction and control from delayed feedback.
